applies_to: CaptiveAire make-up air heater units (including direct-fired) with the factory DDC/BMS package.
summary: CaptiveAire make-up air heaters with the DDC package expose their unit-board data through a factory gateway for BACnet IP or MS/TP. The 161 objects include DDC heat/cool/blower commands, tempering and activation modes, occupied/unoccupied setpoints and blower/damper limits, a 42-point on-board schedule, sensor readings, occupancy flags and six active fault codes. As with the Paragon RTUs, the preferred BMS approach is setpoints plus the DDC Occupied Override binary rather than the raw DDC commands.
notes: Write BV-8 SchedulingEnabled once, set schedule AVs 61-102 to 1440 (no schedule), then use BV-7 DDCOccupiedOverride for occupancy.
DDC command points (BV-1..5, AV-6) require the heat/cool tempering modes (AV-9..12) set to DDC (3); heat and cool can't be called together.
Factory setting points (modes, limits) should not be written routinely.
Temperatures are F or C per the unit's Temp Units setting; the guide gives no engineering units.
Fault AIs 137-142 report codes from the guide's DDC fault list.

source.title: DDC Application Guide for MUA Heater Units

integration.summary: Enable scheduling once (BV-8), set all on-board schedule slots (AV-61..102) to 1440, then drive occupancy from the BMS with BV-7 DDCOccupiedOverride and let the unit temper to its own setpoints. The guide calls setpoint adjustment plus the occupied override the preferred method; the DDC heat/cool/blower commands are only for jobs where the tempering modes are set to DDC. Monitor HVAC state, occupancy flags, temperatures and the six fault-code AIs.

minimum_points.name: SchedulingEnabled
minimum_points.why: Must be on (once) for BV-7 to work

minimum_points.name: CurrentOccupiedStatus
minimum_points.why: Confirms the occupancy command took effect

integration.enable: BV-8 SchedulingEnabled must be on and the internal schedule AVs (61-102) all set to 1440 so BV-7 has full control of occupancy. DDC commands (BV-1..5, AV-6) work only with the heat/cool tempering modes (AV-9..12) set to DDC; this disables temperature-based activation and heat and cool cannot be called together.
setup: Protocessor default device instance 50000, MS/TP MAC 127, 38400 baud; default IP 192.168.1.24 /255.255.255.0.
Web configurator login admin/admin, or the password printed by the gateway's Ethernet port; each change needs Submit and a restart.
The gateway is factory set to BACnet IP or MS/TP for the job; only that port carries BACnet.
gotchas: Factory setting points (modes, limits) should not be written on a regular basis.
SchedulingEnabled only allows scheduling; it is not an occupancy command.
Schedule values are minutes after midnight (0-1439); 1440 means no schedule, and both start and end of a set must be 1440.
The controller board reboots when some factory settings are changed.
